title: Reaper Track Count vs Export Time
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:project project_size=* export_time_min=*
| stats avg(export_time_min) as avg_export_time_min, count as events by project_size
| sort - avg_export_time_min
description: Shows average export time minutes by project size band for Reaper project exports.
value: Average export time minutes by project size band helps compare Reaper project exports across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `export_time_min` on `music:project` events and normalize `project_size` so Splunk can summarize performance by project size band.
visualization: Bar chart of average export time minutes by project size band.
grandmaExplanation: It lists the average export time minutes for each project size band so you can see what works best for Reaper project exports.
